decisive_items: cystoid mass with a stalk attached to the nasal pars plana
Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells
response.rationale: R3 has the most comprehensive raw support spanning location, imaging, histology, and IHC, directly matching the ciliary body mass with stalk and myxoid spindle/stellate cells. R2 and R1 rely only on IHC and histology, lacking the specific anatomical and imaging features. R3's contradiction (negative cytology) is not decisive given the benign variant possibility.

rejected.why: Lacks the specific ciliary body location and imaging features; only S100 and myxoid histology, which are also present in R3, and GFAP positivity is absent, making it less specific.
